answer: The first African American mayor of the most populous city in the United States (New York City) was **David Dinkins**. He served as the 106th Mayor of New York City from January 1, 1990, to December 31, 1993, following his election in November 1989 where he defeated three-term incumbent Ed Koch and Republican candidate Rudolph Giuliani.
